desc:
One hit. Big plays. One more round. 💥

Jump into fast shotgun battles where one clean hit is all it takes. Slide past rivals, land your shot and fight for the top spot!

💥 Shotguns only. Everyone for themselves.
⚡ Slide, dodge and make every shot count.
✨ Collect unique shotgun skins and show off your style.
📈 Earn XP and climb the ranks.
🗺️ Vote for the next map and jump back into action.

Bring your friends. Challenge your rivals. Say GG.

💻 PC CONTROLS
Shoot — Left Mouse Button
Aim — Right Mouse Button
Slide — F / C / Ctrl
Sprint — Left Shift
Reload — R
Jump — Space

📱 MOBILE
Use the on-screen buttons to play.

👍 Having fun? Like and favorite the game!
💬 Join our community to share ideas and report bugs.
